{{Quote|Red Leader, this is Gold Leader.''"<br />"''I copy, Gold Leader.''"<br />"''We're starting for the target shaft now.|Jon "Dutch" Vander to Garven Dreis|<ref name="ANH" />}}
'''Gold Leader''' or '''Gold One''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of [[Gold Squadron]]. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Gold Leader.

==History==
===Galactic Republic===
During the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], a [[Gold Leader (Muunilinst)|clone trooper pilot]] was the Gold Leader of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] unit. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by incoming [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|Geonosian starfighters]].<ref name="CW10">{{CW|10}}</ref>

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] had the call sign Gold Leader during the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]].<ref name="DoD" />

A [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] led the Republic's [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Group]] as Gold Leader in [[Trihexalon attack on Coruscant|defense]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Kinect">''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''</ref>

===Rebel Alliance===
The call sign was used by [[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon "Dutch" Vander]] when he flew with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Vander was killed in the assault against the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="ANH" /><ref name="CCGD">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Dutch}}</ref>

During an [[Battle of the Sixela system|attempted ambush]] of Darth Vader in the [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]], a Rebel using the call sign Gold Leader ordered Alliance forces to follow their [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] adversaries in retreating, escaping the system as it was destroyed by a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] triggered by renegade Imperial Commander [[Rezi Soresh]].<ref name="RFU">''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''</ref>

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was Gold Leader during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] while commanding Gold Group, the force that assaulted and destroyed the second [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

When Gold Squadron&mdash;without Calrissian&mdash;joined the Rebel [[Bakura task force]] during the [[Bakura/Legends|planet's]] [[Invasion of Bakura|invasion]] by the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]] shortly after the Alliance's victory at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], another Gold Leader led the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] against a Ssi-ruuvi [[Wurrif-class light cruiser|''Wurrif''-class light cruiser]], destroying several of the Imperium's [[Swarm-class battle droid|''Swarm''-class battle droids]] in the process.<ref name="TAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>

===Alliance of Free Planets===
Calrissian also served as Gold Leader during the [[Second Battle of Endor]], where the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] repelled the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] fighter squadrons led by [[Lumiya]].<ref name="SW100" />

===New Republic===
During a simulation exercise to qualify for [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles's]] [[Wraith Squadron|new squadron]], [[Kell Tainer]] used the call sign of Gold One.<ref name="XWWS" />

===New Jedi Order===
{{Quote|Gold One to all squadrons. New danger, new danger. Herkan Base is coming alive. Its weapons are now trained on your location, Gray One.|Kyle Katarn|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyle Katarn]] flew under the call sign "Gold One" and led the [[New Jedi Order]]'s [[Gold Squadron (New Jedi Order)|Gold Squadron]] during the [[Operation Shieldfall|battle]] on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]].<ref name="Conviction" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the ''Rogue Squadron'' series of games, Gold Leader was the name of an unlockable field rank, accessed when gaining 61-70 points.
